mentions.name: Plain Invoice
mentions.description: A free invoice generator for freelancers and small businesses that requires no signup. Users fill in their details, pick from 40+ supported currencies, and choose an invoice type (hourly, product, or fixed price), optionally add tax or discounts, then download the PDF or email it directly.
mentions.problem: Existing invoicing tools either require an account, put up a paywall after a few invoices, or are overbuilt for someone who just needs to send a clean invoice.
mentions.audience: Freelancers and small businesses who need to send clean invoices without signing up for an account.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on Plain Invoice (https://plaininvoice.com) — A free invoice generator for freelancers and small businesses. No signup required — just fill in your details, pick a currency (40+ supported), and download
  the PDF or email it directly.
